The '''Bargos's mansion''' was [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]]' headquarters, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
